messages:
maria_cs: FYI Halcyon shows a sharp drop in activity: 38% DAU decline in 14 days. Renewal ~6 weeks. Their CTO (our main champion) left last week and they've promoted a new data lead. possible churn risk. :warning:
jamal_csm: do we have any touchpoints logged with the new data lead?
tyler_ae: i had a reschedule from them last week; they mentioned evaluating a vendor named LumenAI.
olivia_sales: LumenAI is on our competitive radar (custom embeddings + lower pricing). i'll reach out to my contact for details.
maria_cs: quick usage summary (30d):
```
- seats: 42 -> 26
- api calls/day: 12.4k -> 7.6k
- avg tokens/session: 320 -> 200
```
ops-bot: Reminder: renewal_contract_due=2026-05-14; enterprise_support=true.
jamal_csm: suspected causes: lost advocate, new data lead evaluating alternatives, and a batch job regression. recommend: immediate re-onboard + health audit of dropped flows.
tyler_ae: proposed play: (1) 30-min sync with new data lead this week, (2) health-check report with failing routes, (3) offer 2-week free concierge migration with SE.
maria_cs: actions: @tyler_ae schedule sync (target Thu), @olivia_sales confirm whether LumenAI POC is active and scope, @jamal_csm produce health-check artifacts (logs, failing route ids, top-5 errors). i'll draft a re-engage note to send after call is confirmed.
olivia_sales: will ask rep; ETA EOD. :mag_right:
tyler_ae: tentatively booked Thu 10am PT; sending invite with agenda: quick tour, migration pain points, pricing questions.
jamal_csm: checklist for call: (a) sample dropped requests, (b) perf trend graphs, (c) ROI comparison current vs replacement. uploading artifacts to the call invite.
maria_cs: if pricing is brought up, options: temporary seat credit or limited rate discount with a commit. prefer to fix ops issues first.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploy 2026-04-02-824 changed batching defaults for halcyon-org; correlate with drop window.
tyler_ae: that deploy lines up with the start of the decline. tagging eng-runtime for follow-up.
olivia_sales: update: LumenAI says pilot is exploratory and dataset ingestion is incomplete. sounds like we have runway to re-engage.
maria_cs: priority list: (1) verify deploy impact with eng-runtime, (2) 30-min sync with new data lead, (3) gather competitive details from olivia. who owns the internal 'save' playbook?
jamal_csm: i'll own the playbook + health-check. draft due tomorrow noon.
tyler_ae: i'll own the re-engage note and present migration options on the call.
maria_cs: great. keeping this thread as single source for updates. if deploy is causal, i'll open an urgent incident with eng-runtime for a rollback/patch. :white_check_mark:
